before.scope: Read-only automated live desktop check in a fictional demo session; no real-member RSVP write or code change

browser.scope: Desktop/mobile RSVP, event journey, sharing and event smoke specs; local Vite server

accountPersistence.scope: Local Auth/Firestore emulators with fictional verified accounts; no production identity or attendance registration
checks: Verified owner RSVP is acknowledged by the emulator, not browser-only storage
A fresh browser restores the RSVP and cancellation reaches the other browser
Concurrent joins retain both event IDs
Offline cancellation is unconfirmed until reconnect/retry is acknowledged
Another verified account has separate intent and cannot read the owner RSVP
Sign-out closes the event dialog and removes the previous account RSVP

rulesDeployment.scope: Firestore rules only; adds saved_rsvps to the existing verified-owner account section allowlist

limitations: Independent manual RSVP confirmation is pending.
No production member RSVP write or real Google-account login was performed.
Demo RSVP uses isolated browser storage; member persistence is verified using fictional verified accounts in local emulators.
RSVP records personal intent, not host registration, ticketing or attendance; no peer totals are claimed.
